description: Manatee County stormwater design standards — primary eval dataset

qa_pairs.question: What is the minimum pipe cover for a 24 inch RCP in Manatee County?
qa_pairs.ground_truth_answer: LESS THAN FIVE FEET OF COVER OVER THE PIPE

qa_pairs.question: What design storm is required for a local road not in a floodplain in Manatee County?
qa_pairs.ground_truth_answer: For local streets, bridges and culverts not in the published one hundred (100) year floodplain, the design storm shall be twenty-five (25) year frequency.

qa_pairs.question: What is the minimum seasonal high water table clearance for stormwater facilities in Manatee County?
qa_pairs.ground_truth_answer: All roadways shall be designed to provide a minimum of one (1) foot between the bottom of the base course of the roadway and the seasonal high groundwater table.
qa_pairs.ground_truth_section: Section 2.4.2 Minimum Groundwater and High-Water Clearances on page SW-ii / page 4

qa_pairs.question: What is the maximum pond side slope for a dry detention pond in Manatee County?
qa_pairs.ground_truth_answer: The maximum allowable side slope is that of 4:1 (4 feet horizontally for every 1 foot vertical);
qa_pairs.ground_truth_section: Section 2.3.17.A.3 “Detention and Retention System Design Criteria” on page SW-12 / page 16

qa_pairs.question: What is the minimum freeboard requirement for stormwater ponds in Manatee County?
qa_pairs.ground_truth_answer: A minimum of one (1) foot of freeboard will be required, regardless of the design storm or the type of development.
qa_pairs.ground_truth_section: Section 2.3.17 “Detention and Retention System Design Criteria” on page SW-12 / page 16
